title: Basic Int Variables
description:
Variables are just areas in memory that you give a name. You create a variable by typing `DataType VariableName;` There are many data types in C#, but one of the most common data types is int. Int(Integer) is just a whole number, like 27, so creatign a integer variable z would be int z;. There are 3 core terms for variables. Assignment: Changing or seting the value for an existing variable EG: a = 8;. Delcaration: Creating an empty variable, EG: int a;. Finally, Initilization: Creating a variable with a value, EG: int arms = 2;.



The Chronoshard Team needs somthing to store user health! Create the variable MaxHealth which is equal to 100 and CurrentHealth which is equal to MaxHealth
